document.title: Grow followers from comments

source.description_exact: Incentivize a follow to grow your account
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Follow first, then freebie
Business value
Turn random scrollers into ride-or-die followers — no spreadsheet needed.
How does it work?

You tease a juicy lead magnet. They comment. Your automation checks: are they following? If yes, they get the goods. If not, hit ’em with a follow nudge.

selection.choose_when: Use follower verification before a discount code, rather than the guide offered by card 107.
